title: VIXEN queued builds require a manually paired UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The queued VIXEN Release/codegen targets fail during CMake configure at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 unless UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow is supplied. The paired Undertow root should be part of configured VIXEN build/codegen state so the facade consumer can derive it.

title: build-wsl.sh requires --config for queued Release builds
body: The queued invocation bash ./build-wsl.sh Release forwarded raw Release to cmake --build and failed with Unknown argument Release; the working supported form was bash ./build-wsl.sh --config Release. Normalize the wrapper's positional/config argument handling or document and enforce the same form.
